geographic_coverage: Worldwide countries and areas with ISO codes and geographic regions
methodology_notes: Use for country or area names, ISO alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes, and UN geographic regions. M49 inclusion does not establish eSIM availability. Currency must be sourced separately.

geographic_coverage: Worldwide current ISO 4217 currency and funds codes
methodology_notes: Use the official current List One for currency codes. Do not infer country-to-currency mappings from codes alone; verify each entity association and distinguish current from historical currencies.

geographic_coverage: Worldwide economies and territories listed by the World Bank
methodology_notes: Use API fields iso2Code, id, region, and currencyUnit as country metadata. Cross-check currency names against SIX ISO 4217 codes before populating currency_code. World Bank economy coverage is not identical to UN M49 country coverage.
